LEARNING-CONTROL-001.success_metric: Future state schema evolution does not require checker edits unless a semantic invariant changes; true lane/worktree/artifact drift still fails closed.

LEARNING-DOCSYS-ACTIVATION-001.success_metric: Zero reviewed systemic corrections silently treated as active before canonical promotion; learning activation lag/backlog visible in health review.
LEARNING-DOCSYS-ACTIVATION-001.measurement_trigger: learning activation or documentation release promotion

LEARNING-SOURCE-VISIBILITY-001.success_metric: Formal CODE_REVIEW handoffs always state exact source/package identity plus remote source visibility; no reader mistakes partial snapshot for full candidate.

LEARNING-WORKFLOW-CONTINUITY-001.success_metric: Next three interrupted/resumed workflows continue from the last verified step with zero duplicate logical runs and zero repeated completed expensive steps unless identity changed.

LEARNING-LIFECYCLE-CONSISTENCY-002.success_metric: Across subsequent state/session transitions: zero stale active-release learning entries, project learning backlog equals checker-derived backlog, ineffective learnings trigger an explicit successor/meta-review, and no unreviewed correction is auto-promoted.
LEARNING-LIFECYCLE-CONSISTENCY-002.measurement_trigger: first lifecycle inconsistency or after three subsequent canonical state transitions

LEARNING-ADVERSARIAL-FIXTURE-ISOLATION-0.success_metric: The identical adversarial lifecycle regression suite passes on both promotion-ready trees (no final verdicts) and promoted trees (real final verdicts present), while still rejecting partial/mismatched simulated verdict sets.
LEARNING-ADVERSARIAL-FIXTURE-ISOLATION-0.measurement_trigger: next documentation promotion and after three subsequent canonical state transitions

LEARNING-ADVERSARIAL-STATE-INDEPENDENCE-.success_metric: The unchanged lifecycle checker plus the corrected adversarial suite must PASS on a canonical state with zero ambient pending measurements while the synthesized overdue fixture is still rejected as `learning-overdue-measurement-drift`. A later effectiveness measurement must also show the suite remains stable across subsequent canonical lifecycle-state changes. This learning changes regression-fixture construction only. It does not alter lifecycle policy, checker acceptance predicates, product code or native execution authority.
LEARNING-ADVERSARIAL-STATE-INDEPENDENCE-.measurement_trigger: subsequent canonical lifecycle-state changes after V36 activation

LEARNING-PROMOTION-STATE-FINALIZATION-00.success_metric: Across later canonical promotion boundaries, no learning from a completed prior promotion remains dependent on the new promotion's final-review/final-audit fields. Exact lifecycle/adversarial suites remain PASS before and after promotion, and transient promotion state is finalized without deleting immutable evidence.
LEARNING-PROMOTION-STATE-FINALIZATION-00.measurement_trigger: subsequent canonical promotion-state transitions after V37 activation

LEARNING-RECOVERY-STATE-VERSIONING-006.success_metric: Future recovery/control-plane schema changes complete producer migration before stricter consumer success is claimed; no verifier/rehearsal requirement is weakened to accept an old-schema payload; and off-host metadata does not pin rotating state as if it were stable identity.
LEARNING-RECOVERY-STATE-VERSIONING-006.measurement_trigger: next recovery-schema/off-host-metadata change or two subsequent canonical state transitions

LEARNING-EVIDENCE-SEMANTICS-007.success_metric: Future EFFECTIVE transitions bind the immutable success metric to explicit scope/sample/predicate evidence, unrelated existing files cannot satisfy effectiveness, metric-definition drift fails closed, and legitimate DESIGN/REVIEW/AUDIT verdict stages do not generate false promotion-state CI failures.
LEARNING-EVIDENCE-SEMANTICS-007.measurement_trigger: next documentation promotion or semantic-evidence regression
